spec.assertion: Structural: exactly one effect valued 110.44, stat chargeDamagePct, durationSec 15; no chargeDamageMultPct anywhere. Behavioural: a2 total drops when removed, allies byte-identical. Fails under the nearest-wrong chargeDamageMultPct encoding (true multiplier on base charge damage) or a generic attackDamagePct scope.

Carrying block trigger.kind === 'burstCast', target self; plus base total === the burstCast-patched variant AND !== the fullBurstEnter-patched variant. Fails under full-burst-enter keying, which over-credits on rotations the second Burst III (helm) completes and shifts the 15 s window by the cast->FB offset.

it.skip (no radius primitive; single partless boss target). Live guard: no effect valued 100.74 and no projectileExplosionPct effect exists — fails if radius is laundered into an RL Damage-Up stat (a fudge that would inflate every shot for 15 s per burst).

Structural: one flatDamage atkPct 30.1 targeting enemy, core !== true (text says no core strike), noFb !== true (riders take FB by timing). Behavioural: a2 total drops when removed, allies byte-identical.

Cadence by damage-event differencing (removing only the flatDamage effect isolates its fire count, gauge/rotation untouched): fires > 60 over 180 s (~1.37 s/shot RL cycle => ~100+), and fires/halfFires in [1.6, 2.4] vs an every-2-hits patch. Fails under lastBullet (~18), burstCast (~4), or fullBurstEnter keying.

Structural: stat partsDamagePct, durationSec 3, self-targeted, applied at least once. Behavioural inertness: total byte-identical with the effect deleted — fails if encoded as attackDamagePct/coreDamagePct/critDamagePct (the nearest-wrong readings all move damage on a partless boss).

stat atkPct (raw percentage, not casterAtkPct/highestAllyAtkPct flat-resolve), burstCast trigger, target self; every buffApply targetSlug === 'a2'; total drops when removed with allies byte-identical. Fails under an ally-scoped or flat-ATK encoding.

stat chargeSpeedPct, self, burstCast; total strictly drops when removed — proves it is modelled as a shot-count-gating weapon-state modifier rather than dropped as cosmetic. Teammate inertness deliberately NOT asserted (fewer a2 shots => less gauge => legitimate rotation movement).

Both Mode B buffs must carry a defined durationSec in [10,30] s. Derivation: the drain is multiplicative on CURRENT HP, HP(t)=0.9601^t, crossing 40% at ln(0.4)/ln(0.9601) ~= 22.5 s. Fails under a permanent / passive-mode / no-duration model (over-credits ~17.5 s per burst cycle) and under a 40 s+ window. Band is wide so any honest derivation (incl. a 15 s reading) passes — only permanence is caught.
it.skip — v1 models no HP pool, so the drain has no observable payload; its sole damage-side consequence is the Mode B window length, asserted separately.

fixtures: controlComp('a2', true) — liter B1 / crown B2 / a2 B3 (focus) / helm B3, Fire boss, deterministic (no seed). B1+B2 are mandatory because a lone Burst III casts zero full bursts, which would make every burst-keyed assertion vacuous. The fixed second Burst III (helm) is deliberately KEPT rather than passing false: it is what makes 'a2 casts her own burst' and 'the team enters Full Burst' separable, so the skill1 trigger-identity discrimination is non-vacuous; helm's own buffs do not collide with any asserted magnitude. 9 hoisted 180 s runs: base + 8 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals (remove 110.44 / retrigger it to burstCast / retrigger it to fullBurstEnter / remove the 30.1 rider / retrigger the rider to hitCount 2 / remove 40.88 / remove 15.19 / remove 35.88). Structural assertions read the committed override via withPatchedOverride's in-memory clone; blocksOf() accepts both documented file layouts (slot -> Block[] and slot -> { blocks }).
gaps: skill1 'Explosion Radius +100.74% for 15 sec' — it.skip: no radius primitive in the effect schema and the scope-lock boss is a single partless target, so the payload is unobservable. A live guard still asserts it was not encoded as projectileExplosionPct or any 100.74-valued damage stat.

burst 'Effect 1: Current HP -3.99% every 1 sec' — it.skip: v1 models no HP pool (immortal boss, no damage taken), so the drain itself is unobservable. Its only damage-side consequence, the ~22.5 s Mode B self-removal window, is asserted as a FLAGGED derived duration.
